connections.title: Berichtenbox
connections.description: Messages to a citizen's Mijn Overheid Berichtenbox.
connections.unconfiguredMessage: Integriq sends these letters, and it needs a source to send them over. Set the source with occ config:app:set dossiq digital_post_source --value <slug>, naming an integriq digital post source. Until then a send is refused, and the case records why.

adapter.simulatedMessage: A mock adapter answers here, because berichtenbox_adapter names it. No message reaches Mijn Overheid. Clear the key to get the integriq adapter back, which refuses a send it cannot make.
